chunks.subject: AP Psychology
chunks.title: FRQ 2 Evidence-Based Question (EBQ) — 7 points — Set 2: factors influencing helping behavior
chunks.content: AP Psychology FRQ 2, Evidence-Based Question (EBQ), 7 points, based on three sources. Part A [1]: propose a specific, defensible claim. Part B [up to 3]: apply a psychological concept to evidence from each of the three sources. Part C [up to 3]: explain how the evidence supports the claim with psychological reasoning and address scope/limitations. Set 2 topic: factors that influence helping behavior. Same task template as Set 1. Common failure: a claim that restates the prompt; source citation without applied concept; reasoning that restates evidence instead of linking it to the claim.

chunks.subject: AP Psychology
chunks.title: EBQ Set 2 exemplar — Sample 2A, 7/7
chunks.content: EBQ (Set 2) scored 7/7 — a defensible claim, evidence applied from all three sources, and reasoning that links the evidence to the claim and addresses scope. Full-credit model.

chunks.subject: AP Psychology
chunks.title: EBQ Set 2 exemplar — Sample 2B, 4/7
chunks.content: EBQ (Set 2) scored 4/7 — earned the claim and part of the evidence/reasoning, losing about three points where one or more sources were not applied with a concept and reasoning restated evidence. Illustrates a mid-range EBQ short on source application and linkage.

chunks.subject: AP Psychology
chunks.title: EBQ Set 2 exemplar — Sample 2C, 1/7
chunks.content: EBQ (Set 2) scored 1/7 — earned only about one point (typically the claim), with sources not applied and reasoning disconnected from the claim. Illustrates an undeveloped, weakly grounded argument.
